environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in shared VPC. Task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/doc-service-task-role has full DynamoDB access to the user_documents table. IAM policy attached: {Effect: Allow, Action: ['dynamodb:GetItem', 'dynamodb:PutItem', 'dynamodb:DeleteItem', 'dynamodb:Query'], Resource: 'arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111222333444:table/user_documents*'}. No condition keys applied. JWT tokens contain tenant_id and sub claims. All users within the same tenant share the same tenant_id value, meaning any authenticated user can access any other user's documents within the tenant by supplying arbitrary document_id values.

config.iam_policy: Allow dynamodb:* on table/user_documents and table/user_documents/index/*
config.network: Service accessible via internal ALB, no WAF
config.dynamodb_table_schema: partition_key=tenant_id, sort_key=document_id, GSI owner-index on owner_id
